_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base rate shows only 3% chance of ±2 score move in 12h windows and no named breaker is firing, so the skilled call is to stay inside the Anxiety rung until liquidity or fear_greed impulse appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Anxiety; analyst supplies explicit HOLD forward while narrative is silent/measured-only, so forward call follows analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound with fear_greed roughly 32-46 and etf_flows/funding showing no impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed lifts through 46 with etf_flows and stablecoin_growth reversing higher, or funding flips negative and fear_greed breaks under 32
